user.title: Connect the HA Growatt companion
user.description: Keep the HA Growatt app and MQTT running. This companion adds repair notices and buffered-reading events using your existing MQTT connection. It creates no duplicate measurement sensors. Daylight checks use Home Assistant's location and allow two minutes after startup.

data.daylight_alerts: Warn about silent feeds during daylight

abort.mqtt_required: Set up the MQTT integration and start the HA Growatt app first.

init.title: HA Growatt alerts and events
init.description: Missing readings or app status wait until daylight and the sunrise grace period. An explicit app-offline message is reported at any time. Existing readings remain unchanged.

data.daylight_alerts: Warn about silent feeds during daylight

service_offline.title: HA Growatt is not reporting its status
service_offline.description: Check that the HA Growatt app and MQTT broker are running. The app has reported that it is offline, or its status is missing during daylight after the sunrise grace period. Missing status alone does not raise a warning overnight. Saved readings remain visible and may be old. This warning clears when current status messages resume.

decode_failed.title: HA Growatt cannot decode the incoming measurements
decode_failed.description: Open the app and check the inverter's reading profile. Download diagnostics and a support capture if the model is not recognised. New session-key encrypted dataloggers need additional protocol support; changing profiles does not decrypt them.

feed_stale.title: A Growatt inverter is silent during daylight
feed_stale.description: Inverter {inverter} has sent no fresh reading for at least {minutes} minutes. Check its power, datalogger connection and selected reading profile. Normal overnight silence is excluded, with a grace period after sunrise. The warning clears when fresh readings arrive or night begins.
